title: Ask toward an open problem: Erdős's conjecture on arithmetic progressions
statement: Propose five candidate un-asked questions, each smaller than the open problem below and each such that its answer would bear on it. Problem OP-MATH-ERDOS-AP: Does every set of positive integers whose reciprocals have a divergent sum contain arithmetic progressions of every finite length? Each candidate must pass the Depth requirement of LEDGER.md, must not be a duplicate of ledger/INDEX.md, must not be the problem itself or a known reformulation of it, and must carry a bears_on link to OP-MATH-ERDOS-AP saying how its answer would bear on the problem.

problem_source.title: Breaking the logarithmic barrier in Roth's theorem on arithmetic progressions
